sentences.l2: 近ごろ、コンピューターがとても上手に仕事をするようになりました。
sentences.l1: Recently, computers have come to do work very skillfully.

sentences.l2: そのため、会社で仕事をなくす人がふえています。
sentences.l1: As a result, the number of people losing their jobs at companies is increasing.

sentences.l2: だから国は、新しい仕事のやり方をおしえる学校をつくり、みんなでお金をわけ合う方法も考えています。
sentences.l1: So the country is setting up schools that teach new ways of working, and is also considering a way for everyone to share money.
